about_the_game:
Adventure calls in Nikoderiko: The Magical World - Director's Cut, a love letter to classic platformers! Run, jump, and ride with Niko and Luna through colorful levels full of danger, treasures, and super-sized bosses. Play on your own or together with a friend in couch co-op. Also, play anywhere with your Steam Deck!

Play the Demo to experience:

• 3 Vibrant Levels: Journey into Sacred Forest, delve into the Tricky Caves, and escape Riptor's rage in Snowland!

• Full VO: Enjoy voice acting in English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, and Mandarin Chinese.

• Director's Cut Enhancements: Nikoderiko: The Magical World got a free upgrade! All the improvements in the full game are present in the Demo.

Jump into a new adventure with Niko and Luna!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
